name: print-social-poster-yellow-black-workshop-photo-split
title: Yellow/black World Graphics Day workshop poster
whatItIs: A vertical A4 poster split into a black headline zone, a yellow-duotone photo of a designer at a desk, and a blue footer zone with registration details and concentric arc decoration.
whatItMeans: Splitting the poster into three horizontal color zones (black/yellow/blue) creates clear reading order — hook, proof, action — without needing any borders or dividers.
techniques: stack three flat-colored horizontal zones to create implicit hook/proof/action reading order
duotone a photo into the poster's accent color so it doesn't need its own separate palette
add a corner grid texture over the photo zone for a subtle 'design tool' reference

vocabulary.definition: the implied sequence in which a viewer's eye moves through a composition's zones or elements
